claims.evidence: No brand or model name is legible on the engine in Photo 0.
Engine size, cylinder count, and configuration are not shown.
No guarantee document or warranty terms are visible in the photos.
Import status and foreign-used origin cannot be determined from the photos.
Country of origin is not shown in any photo.
Whether the engine starts or runs is not shown.
Internal condition and mechanical faults are not shown.
Mileage or age of the engine is not shown.
Repair history and whether internals were opened are not shown.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running, or a compression test result.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage such as knock, worn bearings, or pistons
risks.proof: Borescope inspection clip or mechanic compression/leak-down test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing a full rebuild

risks.risk: Wrong make, model, or engine configuration
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine block identification plate and VIN.

risks.risk: Missing ECU, wiring harness, or transmission
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories alongside the engine.
Service history or verifiable odometer reading from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage or unknown age

risks.proof: Import or customs documents showing Belgium origin.

proof_requests: Clear photo of engine identification plate and any visible model markings
Video of the engine starting and running
Compression test or borescope inspection clip
Photo of all included accessories such as ECU and wiring harness
Import or customs documents if claiming Tokunbo from Belgium
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car engine, so it can be priced at its worst case; every seller claim is unverified or unverifiable remotely and internal condition is unknown.
